Doctor Linked to Lucy Letby Found Dead

Dr. Mark Deakin, identified as the 'boyfriend' of convicted child murderer Lucy Letby, was found dead in his car. He had been reported missing, and a welfare check led to the discovery. The circumstances of his death are not detailed beyond him being found dying during the welfare check.
